name: elasticsearch
description: Elasticsearch integration — search with the Query DSL, run ES|QL queries, count and fetch documents, list indices, inspect mappings and cluster health, and index documents over the REST API. Authenticates with an API key (Authorization: ApiKey) or HTTP basic auth (username + password), and supports custom CA certificates for self-signed TLS. Works with Elastic Cloud, Elastic serverless, self-managed Elasticsearch 8/9, and OpenSearch (basic auth). AWS OpenSearch domains in IAM/SigV4-only mode are not supported.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Search, query, and index documents in an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch cluster

fields.label: Cluster URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the cluster REST API, e.g. https://my-cluster.es.us-east-1.aws.elastic.cloud:443 or https://localhost:9200.

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Base64 API key (the encoded id:key string Kibana shows when you create an API key). If set, it is used instead of username/password.

fields.label: Username
fields.helpText: Username for HTTP basic auth (e.g. elastic). Required together with password when no API key is set. Use this for OpenSearch.

fields.label: Password
fields.helpText: Password for HTTP basic auth. Required together with username when no API key is set.

fields.label: CA Certificate (PEM)
fields.helpText: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust, for clusters with self-signed or private-CA TLS certificates.

fields.label: Skip TLS Verification
fields.helpText: Set to 'true' to skip TLS certificate verification (not recommended — prefer providing the CA certificate).

tools.name: es.search
tools.description: Search an index with the Elasticsearch Query DSL and return trimmed hits (id, index, score, source) plus totals and any aggregation results.

index.description: Index name, alias, comma-separated list, or wildcard pattern (e.g. logs-*)

query.description: Query DSL query object (e.g. {"match": {"message": "error"}}). Omit to match all documents.

sort.description: Query DSL sort clause passed through as-is (e.g. [{"@timestamp": "desc"}])

aggs.description: Query DSL aggregations object passed through as-is

tools.name: es.esql_query
tools.description: Run an ES|QL query (e.g. FROM logs-* | WHERE level == "error" | LIMIT 10) and return columns and row values. Requires Elasticsearch 8.11+; not available on OpenSearch.

tools.name: es.count
tools.description: Count documents in an index, optionally filtered by a Query DSL query.

index.description: Index name, alias, comma-separated list, or wildcard pattern

query.description: Query DSL query object to filter the count. Omit to count all documents.

tools.name: es.get_document
tools.description: Get a single document by index and document id.

tools.name: es.list_indices
tools.description: List indices in the cluster with health, document count, and store size, sorted by index name.

tools.name: es.get_mapping
tools.description: Get the field mappings (properties) of an index.

index.description: Index name, alias, or wildcard pattern

tools.name: es.cluster_health
tools.description: Get cluster health: status, node counts, and shard statistics.

tools.name: es.index_document
tools.description: Index (create or overwrite) a document. With an id it is written via PUT to that id, overwriting any existing document; without an id a new document is created with an auto-generated id.

document.description: The document body as a JSON object

id.description: Document id. If given, overwrites any existing document with that id; if omitted, an id is auto-generated.
